input.description: Sum all invoice amounts where status is "paid"

input.command: echo "Invoices with 'paid' status:" && awk -F',' '$4 == "paid" {print $1, $3}' invoices.csv && echo "---" && awk -F',' '$4 == "paid" {sum += $3; count++} END {print "Count: " count ", Total: " sum}' invoices.csv
input.description: Show all paid invoices and verify the sum
